notes: Only single_*.npz records contribute to official statistics; persistence is diagnostic.
One saved fresh-single record is one acquisition; multiple edge pairs within it are not extra independent acquisitions.
Freshness provenance comes from the collector and saved metadata, not from deduplicating similar quantized waveforms.
Fine single-edge records cannot verify pulse period or absolute PTP epoch identity.
Sub-sample linear interpolation is not evidence of picosecond timing accuracy.

relative_to_A_M1.qualification: Operator-declared baseline; this subtraction alone does not establish true PTP clock error
relative_to_A_M1.meaning: Relative to the A M1 REF/OBS output-path baseline; B/C results include transfer of GPIO/PCB paths.
relative_to_A_M1.note: Constant mean subtraction only. No variance-floor subtraction or implied intrinsic jitter/precision.

instrument_corrected.qualification: Operator-declared baseline; this subtraction alone does not establish true PTP clock error
instrument_corrected.meaning: Common-SYNC instrument/probe bias removed; GPIO/PCB differences remain.
instrument_corrected.note: Constant mean subtraction only. No variance-floor subtraction or implied intrinsic jitter/precision.
